candidateDetection: runtime scans enabled building-like renderers, groups them by safe bldg/building root, and excludes roads, ground cover, water, support, air walls, markers, UI, player, and NPCs
perBuildingRuntimeDetail: aggregate runtime counts are emitted in Player.log; object-level scene details are intentionally not written by the player build
knownSafetyPolicy: only building-like roots are eligible; X/Z, rotation, and scale are preserved; extreme offsets above maxSnapdownMeters are skipped
expectedAction: snap floating building roots downward to the current gameplay ground cover at runtime
